name: Command Authority (Command Points Duel)
description: Command Points duel on top of the RTS (iteration 3): earn CP from kills (nearest-hostile attribution), damage dealt (1 CP / 400 hp, fractional bank) and alternating DIRECTIVES (HUNT the enemy's priciest unit / DEFEND yours, +8 CP each). Spend on Z Reinforce (front-line) / X Repair / C Blitz / V Sabotage. DOCTRINE: the AI Director NEVER EMPs unasked - it repairs its wounded, reinforces at its own last kill site, and answers your Sabotage with one announced retaliation (5 s warning). Multiplayer gate: with 2+ human houses the simulation-writing powers lock; deterministic systems only.
author: LuaAPI Research
